question: A 20-year-old G1P0 woman at 12 weeks estimated gestational age presents to the obstetric clinic for the first prenatal visit She admits to being unsure of whether to keep or abort the pregnancy but now has finally decided to keep it. She says she is experiencing constant fatigue. Physical examination reveals conjunctival pallor. Her hemoglobin level is 10.1 g/dL. Which of the following additional features would likely be present in this patient?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Iron deficiency -> Anemia -> Fatigue -> 80% CHAIN: Anemia -> Conjunctival pallor -> 70% CHAIN: Anemia -> Low hemoglobin level -> 90% CHAIN: Iron deficiency -> Pica -> 60% CHAIN: Iron deficiency -> Onychorrhexis -> 50% CHAIN: Iron deficiency -> Increased Transferrin Saturation -> 40% CHAIN: Iron deficiency -> Decreased TIBC -> 80%
analysis: The patient is presenting with symptoms of fatigue and conjunctival pallor, which are indicative of iron deficiency anemia. Given her hemoglobin level of 10.1 g/dL, it is likely that she may also exhibit the symptom of pica, which is a craving for non-food substances like ice, dirt, or starch commonly seen in iron deficiency anemia.
